description: This receipt is issued by Dunelm and identifies the location as Reading, with store number 0670 displayed in the header. The receipt contains retailer branding, a customer-service message, and a VAT registration number. POS transaction metadata includes a transaction reference number, transaction date and time, till number, transaction ID, and payment-card information with a masked Mastercard account reference. The financial section records the transaction total, item count, and payment amount processed through the card transaction. A barcode is included for transaction tracking and audit purposes. The footer contains customer-survey and feedback invitations, online shopping references, a website address, and additional transaction-control information. The overall layout is representative of a United Kingdom home furnishings and retail POS receipt, combining VAT-compliant reporting, payment documentation, customer-engagement messaging, and transaction-tracking controls within a compact retail receipt format.
